name: miniytb
description: MiniYTB - nền tảng xem video trực tuyến theo kiến trúc microservices

scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d mongo rabbitmq mailpit
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n gateway,user,video,stream,comment,payment,web -c gray,blue,green,magenta,cyan,yellow,white "npm run dev -w services/gateway" "npm run dev -w services/user-service" "npm run dev -w services/video-service" "npm run dev -w services/streaming-service" "npm run dev -w services/comment-service" "npm run dev -w services/payment-service" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently -k -n gateway,user,video,stream,comment,payment -c gray,blue,green,magenta,cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w services/gateway" "npm run dev -w services/user-service" "npm run dev -w services/video-service" "npm run dev -w services/streaming-service" "npm run dev -w services/comment-service" "npm run dev -w services/payment-service"
